profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, trading on the stock exchange under the ticker BOX. The company describes itself as an intelligent content management platform that enables organizations to store, share, collaborate on, and automate workflows around unstructured data such as documents, presentations, and contracts, with enterprise-grade security and compliance tools covering requirements including GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA.

Box's primary AI product is Box AI, categorized as an enterprise content AI offering that the company describes as integrating leading AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, deep analysis, and smart recommendations across enterprise content. The platform also includes Box AI Studio, which allows developers to build and customize agents, along with a drag-and-drop workflow builder for automating processes such as loan processing and employee onboarding. The site also notes AI-driven e-signature capabilities and deep learning-based malware detection built into the platform.

According to SEC filings, Box reported revenue of $1,177,253,000 for the period ending January 31, 2026, based on a 10-K filing. No litigation is recorded in the held facts. The site holds a page in the registry and no MCP servers are attributed directly to Box in the tracked data.
